# Spaced Repetition

## When to use

Scheduling method that reviews material just before it would be forgotten, so it is remembered for longer. Use when a learner has a long list of facts (vocabulary, definitions, dates) or an exam weeks away.

## Steps

1. Put each item on a card with a question on the front and the answer on the back.
2. Review new cards the next day. If correct, review again after about 3 days, then about a week, then about 2-3 weeks.
3. If a card is wrong, bring it back the next day.
4. Limit daily reviews to a number you can finish (for example 30-50 cards).

## Example

A language learner adds 20 new words a day as cards with a full example sentence on the back. Reviews are done each morning in the order the app schedules them.

## Common mistakes

- Adding too many new cards per day, so reviews pile up
- Writing cards that contain several facts at once
- Stopping the schedule during a busy week and never restarting it

## Coach rules

- Explain the method briefly, then have the learner try it on their own material straight away.
- Check at the end of the session: did the learner actually do the method, or only talk about it?
